title: Modular house with overseas-prefabricated modules and a MultiProof certificate (consent refused)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE Chief Executive determination; Building Act 2004; comparative only, not Alberta)

facts.text: Proposed house of 64 m2 with two bedrooms, a bathroom and an open-plan kitchen, living and dining area, on a sloping rural site; surrounded by 120 m2 of raised timber decking and a swimming pool.
Two prefabricated building modules manufactured overseas are delivered to the site; the modules are constructed from a heavy steel alloy.
The module design was not supported by a MultiProof certificate when the consent application was made; the authority maintained its refusal after one was issued.
Figure 1 shows the detail of the proposed dwelling layout submitted for stage 2.
